item.title: Suspect Arrested in Stolen BMW Linked to Series of Manitoba Break-Ins
item.description: A 38-year-old man is facing multiple charges after being arrested in a stolen SUV and linked to a string of commercial break-ins across southern Manitoba.

item.title: Three Arrested in Interlake as Violent Offender Unit Targets Outstanding Warrants
item.description: Three people have been arrested in Manitoba’s Interlake region as part of a targeted operation aimed at suspects with outstanding warrants.

item.title: Sio Silica Partners with UM on Low-Emission Silicon Battery Research
item.description: Alberta-based Sio Silica Corp. has partnered with the University of Manitoba to develop a single-step process for producing high-performance silicon battery materials from high-purity silica.

item.title: 12-Year-Old Boy Dies in Portage la Prairie House Fire
item.description: A 12-year-old boy is dead following an early morning house fire in Portage la Prairie over the weekend.

item.title: Red River Section of Skating Trail Closing for Rail Bridge Maintenance
item.description: The Red River portion of the Nestaweya River Trail will close to allow for maintenance work on the Historic Rail Bridge before ice conditions change.

item.title: Winnipeg Man Charged After Alleged Online Threats to Prime Minister
item.description: A 55-year-old Winnipeg man has been charged after allegedly making online threats towards Prime Minister Mark Carney and others.

item.title: Remains of 81-Year-Old Man Recovered After Fatal Nassau Street House Fire
item.description: WINNIPEG -- The remains of an 81-year-old man have been recovered following a fatal Winnipeg house fire last weekend.

item.title: Downtown Winnipeg BIZ Launches ‘Dine and Discover’ to Spice Up Late-Winter Slump
item.description: Winnipeggers looking to shake off the late-winter chill will soon have a new excuse to grab a table downtown.

item.title: Winnipeg Security Guard Arrested After Alleged Assault in Downtown Dollarama
item.description: A security guard has been arrested following the assault on a suspected shoplifter at a downtown convenience store last weekend, police say.

item.title: New Flyer Opens All-Canadian Bus Manufacturing Facility in Winnipeg
item.description: New Flyer has opened a new all-Canadian bus manufacturing facility in Winnipeg, calling it a major boost for domestic production, job creation and zero-emission transit.
